chunks: And Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from a number of our companions from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Safwan from Abu Sa'id al-Mukari from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"There is no harm in applying perfume before entering the state of Ihram for fifteen days." And when fifteen days have passed, it is preferable for him to renew the cleansing; he narrated that.

key_terms.التَّنْظِيفُ: Cleansing / Purity (specifically from scent in this context)
key_terms.الْإِحْرَامُ: The state of ritual consecration for Hajj or Umrah

ai.seo_question: How long before Hajj can one apply perfume before entering Ihram?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the fiqh of Ihram by permitting the application of perfume up to fifteen days prior, establishing a clear window for ritual purity. It highlights the scholarly preference for renewing cleanliness immediately before entering the sacred state, ensuring the pilgrim is free from lingering scents during the Tawaf and Sa'i. This ruling reflects the practical balance between maintaining personal hygiene and adhering to the spiritual constraints of the Miqat.
